summary: User-selected simplification retains actual shutdown and original-effect custody while removing a mandatory report/PR on every stop. The board, owning issues and native PR/operation evidence hold current scope, ownership, accepted progress, blockers and next actions; Atlas holds curated knowledge and stable retrieval pointers. A stop reconciles those records within existing authority and returns their restart pointer when sufficient. Only missing recovery information is saved: local/interrupted work, actual running or Unknown jobs, cleanup, original consumed/uncertain attempts, private evidence paths, pending reply identities/deadlines and absent authorization constraints. A separate timestamped report and normal save PR are conditional on a genuine repository recovery gap, not required ceremony. Continuation starts from current native issue/board and Atlas pointers and consults old reports only for missing obligations; no optional report absence is a blocker. Dirty work, privacy, qualified binding/caller boundaries, original reservations and uncertain effects remain preserved; fresh native/action admission is required before execution. The change neither stops another session when the skill is edited nor grants new enrollment, planning writes, retries, publication or installed fleet adoption. Source delivery and current runtime consumption remain distinct.
title: Stop preserves recovery gaps and resumes from durable issue and Atlas pointers
